posts.cooked: I would disagree.   Depending on order of things you could still lose cards that get destroyed at the start of your turn even if you do eventually if you choose to skip your turn.   In this case Throat Jab or similar effects would be in play before the character's removal so it begs the question to me whether a hero who has been removed still has a turn even if they have nothing in play.
